title: Opsis visual manifest
description: Describes one visual plugin at frontend/src/visuals/<id>/manifest.json. The editor builds field wells from roles and the config panel from configSchema. The backend and MCP server use the same file to list visuals and validate dashboard items.

id.description: Must equal the folder name. Referenced by items[].visual in a dashboard spec.

roles.description: Field wells. Keys are role names used in items[].bindings. Use an empty object for visuals with no data (text).

configSchema.description: A JSON Schema (type object) for items[].config. Rendered with rjsf, so keep it flat and give every property a default.

aiHints.description: Guidance passed to the agent: when to pick this visual and its sensible limits.

crossFilter.description: Clicking a mark can emit a cross-filter on the bound dimension.

drillDown.description: Supports drilling through time grains on a time dimension.

kind.description: What may be bound. A time dimension counts as a dimension.

types.description: Optional restriction on the dimension type, for example ["time"] for a line chart x axis.

axis.description: When true, each measure bound to this role may choose a value axis with {"field": ..., "axis": "left" | "right"}.
